method: Every assigned page individually viewed at original PNG resolution using view_image(detail=original), in two batches of six pages. Contact sheets were not used as sole evidence.

findings.observation: Sharp readable text and mathematics, unclipped figures and captions, comfortable margins and no overlapping content.
Opening spills to a sparse continuation of about 150 words. Recommended modest local font/spacing compaction or explicit editorial acceptance as a two-page preface.
Chapter 8 is split across contents pages, leaving section 8.4 alone above a sparse appendix/source continuation. Recommended a deliberate TOC break before chapter 6 or 7 for balance.
Chapter title hyphenates completely as com-/pletely. Recommended shorter Five complete field realizations title or explicit line break before completely.
